units.summary: An en_EN.json entry's value must not equal its (flattened, '|'-joined) key
units.evidence: matrix-i18n-lint, run by i18n:lint in apps/web and packages/shared-components under the i18n_check workflow (static_analysis.yaml:140). The rule list is recalled from the upstream tool's documentation (not readable from the clone). Clone data is consistent only with full-path comparison: 3 nested leaves (common edited/unavailable, a nested 'default') equal their leaf name but not their path
units.alint: constraint over entry-json rows (key path, value) asserting value != key path
units.reason: Needs (key path, value) rows, which no adapter emits (the entry adapter is key-only). Once they exist, the assertion is a scalar comparison of the two fields of one row (equality, negated).

changes.why: Stage A says the entry-json row adapter exists, so this is B-config. That is wrong. EntryRowsAdapter is key-only by design: crates/alint-core/src/relation/adapters/entry.rs:11-17 says 'values are not parsed, because key_parity never needs them' and emits RowState::Key. ExtractAdapter rows carry pointer None (adapters/extract.rs:88-93), so values cannot be joined back to key paths. general-linter.md 7.3 calls json_entries (key+value rows) a proposed extractor, and the v0.23 README lists only entry, extract, TOML and XML adapters. key != '|'-joined key path therefore needs a new value-bearing entry adapter plus a path-join transform. Consequence: Stage A's 'after the slice, 05 moves to A' projection is invalid; this repo has no B-config unit.
The batch 2 ruling keeps the family an entry-values unit will need. value != key path is a negated scalar equality on one row, as mattermost-32 (value equals its key) is `equality`.

No dependency-version consistency gate (no syncpack, manypkg, sherif, yarn constraints or catalogMode strict)
No translation-side locale gate: no key parity, placeholder or plural-form check on non-en_EN files (Localazy owns them; inverted plural maps exist at the pin)

No Makefile, justfile or Taskfile; tasks are package.json scripts and nx targets
No CI other than GitHub Actions (no CircleCI, GitLab, Azure, Buildkite, Jenkins)
No commit-message lint (squash merge uses the PR title)
The .editorconfig is ungated (editorconfig_conforms reports 3,293 findings; oxfmt is the real formatting gate)
unusual: The whole i18n gate is an external reusable workflow pinned by SHA (matrix-org/matrix-web-i18n i18n_check.yml@6eda3835), with the brand-word allowlists written inline in the static_analysis.yaml matrix as key paths ('devtools|settings|elementCallUrl')
Repo-wide oxfmt ignores src/i18n/strings; locale files are formatted only through each package's `pnpm i18n` -> i18n:lint, caught by the i18n workflow's git diff

Three locale catalogs (apps/web, apps/desktop, packages/shared-components) with identical 41-locale sets; a bespoke webpack plugin (apps/web/I18nWebpackPlugin.ts) merges shared-components strings into each apps/web language and generates languages.json at build time
Inverted plural maps ('<translated text>': 'one') in cy, hu and nb_NO translations at the pin, found with key_parity (plurals: cldr) and a targeted regex; nothing in CI validates translations
CODEOWNERS deliberately un-owns the translation directories (the Localazy bot updates them) but assigns en_EN.json to reviewers

Zizmor-gated rules element-web-gha-checkout-persist-credentials (unit 27) and element-web-gha-actions-pinned (unit 28): the gate is unverified. stage_b_summary:
I re-ran Stage A's config against the clone at e84183a6b2 and the result matches its record: validate-config loads 17 rules, check exits 0, and the only findings are the 6 info from element-web-i18n-no-inverted-plurals. I reproduced the fire tests on scratch copies. Unit 14 (the toolchain-pin A unit) fires as claimed. The locale C rules (04 and 08) fire as claimed, but each has an undocumented false negative: a single-line en_EN.json for 04, and a leading BOM for 08.

Corrections:
(1) Units 05 and 06 move from B-config to B-adapter. The relation layer's entry-json adapter is key-only and value rows carry no pointer, so no adapter today gives (key path, value) rows. That also removes Stage A's claim that 05 moves to A after the slice.
(2) Remove unit 14. Renovate update grouping is not a stated invariant: nothing fails on drift, and the desktop Playwright Dockerfile reinstalls pnpm@latest-11 anyway.
(3) Add four missed units:
- A: committed Playwright baselines are Linux-only. This is a separate check inside the stale-screenshot reporter.
- A: Web and Desktop versions match. docs/release.md and docs/monorepo.md document it; it was mislabelled value-add.
- D: the SonarCloud required status.
- B-adapter (locale, convention): translators keep %(x)s placeholders and markup tags, per docs/translating.md. The clone has 70 violations, so nothing gates it.

Verification limits:

Their checks were reconstructed from four sources: the inputs static_analysis.yaml passes (hardcoded-words, allowed-hardcoded-keys, path, packageManager), each package's i18n scripts, docs/translating-dev.md, and my recollection of matrix-i18n-lint's documented rules. Those rules are key != value, the key charset with '@' and '.' tolerated temporarily, and hardcoded words via env. The clone's data is consistent with each one: the apps/web allowlist matches the Element-bearing values exactly, all keys fall in [A-Za-z0-9_@.], and no flattened key path equals its value. Stage B should still treat units 05, 06 and 07 as reconstructed.
2. pnpm failing install whenever the project's own engines.node is unmet (unit 13) comes from pnpm documentation.
3. action-validator's glob check (unit 21) comes from its documentation.
4. The zizmor-action default (advanced-security, SARIF to code scanning) may make zizmor findings advisory rather than job-failing. Units 27-29 are counted on the strength of the inline ignores, which show maintainers act on findings.

Judgement calls Stage B may revisit:
- Unit 14 (pnpm pin coherence) is convention tier. It rests on Renovate grouping, not a failing gate, and was counted the way mastodon's renovate sync comments were. Without it, toolchain-pin has no A unit.
- I did not count a separate unit for pnpm's catalog:/workspace: reference integrity or for patch application and allowBuilds. They are folded into the frozen-lockfile unit 10. Splitting them would add B-config/reference units.
- Zizmor dangerous-triggers and secrets-inherit are structural YAML checks that could be split out of unit 29 as C units.
- The desktop build-artifact checks were split into 4 D units (35-38).
